candidate.title: CRISPR-UMI
candidate.scope: The CRISPR-UMI row of the assigned Illumina single-cell poster: UMI-linked guide design, pooled CRISPR/Cas9 editing, selection and expansion, limiting dilution, clonal expansion, guide-construct DNA purification/amplification and sequence-based guide-efficiency readout. The left efficiency cartoon is a conceptual overview. The lower TSCS row (frozen tissue slices, UV-catapulting, DOP-PCR and cell-specific barcodes) is adjacent context with no connecting route and is outside this card. This is a schematic-level implementation, not a reconstruction of the complete 2017 protocol.

states.label: CRISPR-UMI guide-encoding construct library
features: Design inset orders i5, gRNA, UMI and i7; the caption specifies a gene-specific spacer, random 10 nt UMI barcode and Illumina indexed adaptors, flanked by PacI restriction sites.
Three coloured guide drawings indicate library diversity. The hairpin is a schematic guide/scaffold symbol; the drawing does not specify a chemical end group.
The guide and UMI association is carried by the construct. These UMIs tag cell lineages for the screen; no transcript-counting assay is depicted.

states.label: Founder cells retained through limiting dilution
features: Three arrows terminate in separate green, blue and red single-cell icons, representing different editing outcomes or lineages.
This state represents the collection of distinct founders; it does not assert that their contents are mixed or that they occupy specified wells.

evidence.locator: CRISPR-UMI row, Limiting dilution: three arrows to green, blue and red founder icons; caption below

states.label: Clonally expanded descendants of retained founders
features: One blue colony is drawn as the representative result of Expand; the caption says cells in a colony contain the same UMI sequence associated with the specific gRNA.

The multiple founder icons and representative colony explain lineage propagation, rather than three named alternative workflows. Physical pooling or individual downstream processing of each depicted colour is not specified.
Interpretation: the shared UMI is inherited from the common tagged founder. The caption is not taken to imply that every cell exposed to the same guide must have the same UMI.

states.label: Purified and amplified guide-construct DNA library
features: The arrow is explicitly labelled Purify DNA and amplify; the endpoint is three gRNA constructs drawn with coloured guide segments and the scaffold/UMI/adaptor layout established by the design inset.
The sequenced carrier is amplified construct DNA representing guide identity and its associated lineage barcode, rather than the edited genomic target sequence or an RNA-expression library.
The three endpoint constructs illustrate library diversity; they do not establish that the representative blue colony contains three different guides.

operations.label: Edit, select, expand
operations.description: Bring the guide-construct library together with the cell suspension and perform the depicted editing, selection and expansion block, yielding a heterogeneous population of edited cells. The schematic groups these actions and does not specify their internal procedures.
operations.mechanism: CRISPR/Cas9 editing is identified in the left overview; no delivery chemistry or selection mechanism is specified.
operations.information_effect: Establishes the construct-associated guide/UMI tags in cells whose descendants can be followed during the screen. The abstract supports individually tagged clonal screening; it does not verify a particular delivery implementation.

operations.label: Limiting dilution
operations.description: Reduce the heterogeneous population to retained single-cell founders; the three outgoing arrows and coloured founders depict separation of different editing outcomes into lineages for clonal expansion.
operations.mechanism: Strong limiting dilution, as stated in the caption; no compartment format or dilution amount is specified.
operations.information_effect: Restricts the founders that contribute descendants, allowing different tagged lineages to be tracked separately in the screen without equating guide identity with a unique editing outcome.

operations.label: Expand
operations.description: Expand the retained founders into clonal descendants. A single blue colony illustrates the result; the figure does not show separate downstream processing lanes for all three founder icons.
operations.mechanism: Cell proliferation; the caption states that cells within a colony share the associated gRNA and UMI sequence.
operations.information_effect: Propagates the founder-associated UMI into descendants so the barcode can represent a clone. Interpretation: common tagged ancestry explains the shared UMI; the same guide sequence can be associated with distinct tagged lineages and editing outcomes.

unknowns.question: How are the linked guide and UMI positioned across sequencing reads, and how are clone measurements compared to quantify the desired outcome? The drawing supports a guide/UMI construct readout but supplies neither read assignment nor comparison design; primary methods or an assay read-layout figure would be needed for a more detailed interface.

Does limiting dilution here retain founders in a reduced pooled culture or physically isolate them into separate compartments, and how are expanded lineages presented to DNA purification? The diagram depicts separate founder icons and one representative colony but no wells, pooling junction or complete lineage-specific processing lanes; a primary workflow description would be needed to specify that physical handling.

checks.rationale: All required targets were checked against the actual image and supplied source text. The eight states, six operations and thirteen routes cover the in-scope design, joint editing block, limiting dilution, clonal expansion, DNA preparation and caption-defined sequencing/assessment. The sole multi-input operation is supported by an explicit plus sign. Founder identities remain distinct in the collection-level representation; no independent processing lanes are collapsed or unshown pooling asserted. The DNA carrier, guide/UMI association and output limitations agree across interfaces. CRISPR-UMI is the only assigned target, and its one listed reference is bibliographically matched with abstract-level scientific support. The hairpin symbols and shared-colony caption are interpreted explicitly without claiming a contradictory RNA substrate or guide-defined unique lineage. No consequential unsupported assertion, missing depicted transformation, incompatible method assignment or required source correction remains. Both unknowns concern unshown detail and remain nonblocking at the stated scope.
